notes: Adds the KAYAS 40+80+80 service model to the DCTS preview package: 40 IaaS/Cloud, 80 Managed Colocation and 80 Colocation cabinets; provisional 2+4+4 pod mapping; shared DC service layer; and a 10-cabinet AI/high-density capability overlay. The 40+80+80 service split is retained as a vendor proposal, pod numbering remains a working assumption, and AI commercial allocation remains pending. The legacy production topology is not modified.
